titre: Capacité absorbée sur les grands marchés nord-américains
sous_titre: Mégawatts nets absorbés, années 2024 et 2025 puis premier semestre 2026

2024.texte: Primary markets posted record net absorption of 2,497.6 MW in 2025, outpacing the previous record of 1,809.5 MW in 2024.

2025.texte: Primary markets posted record net absorption of 2,497.6 MW in 2025, outpacing the previous record of 1,809.5 MW in 2024.

1er semestre 2026.texte: Net absorption across primary markets increased by 11.7% year-over-year to 1,456.2 MW in H1.
